name: Beel Beelzebub
source:
Number 3 of the mafia group 'Evening Star'.
His true form is of the crude and ugly king of flies, a demon who rules over the night.
His specialty is transforming into animals.
He has a cheerful personality that goes with his boyish looks and he really loves candy and is always walking around with something sweet.
A surprisingly hard working guy whose dream is to surpass his superiors, he is really fed up with his lazy boss.
